name: Unitectra
description: Technology transfer office of the Universities of Bern, Basel and Zurich. Handles licensing of University of Bern inventions and patents, research and collaboration contracts with industry, and spin-off support. The first stop for a company that wants to license or co-develop unibe research.

name: CTU Bern (Clinical Trials Unit)
description: Clinical Trials Unit of the University of Bern and Inselspital. Supports clinical studies with study design, statistics, data management, monitoring and regulatory submissions; a contact point for companies planning a clinical trial or a medical device clinical investigation in Bern.

name: Swiss Clinical Trial Organisation (SCTO)
description: National academic research infrastructure for clinical research, the network of the Swiss clinical trial units including CTU Bern. Training, tools, best practice and expert services for clinical trials in all therapeutic areas.

name: swissethics
description: Umbrella organisation of the Swiss research ethics committees, including the cantonal ethics committee of Bern. Runs BASEC, the portal for submitting clinical trial and human research projects for ethics approval, with templates and checklists.

name: Human Research Switzerland (SNCTP study portal)
description: Federal portal on research involving human beings, with the search for ongoing and completed clinical studies in Switzerland (Swiss National Clinical Trials Portal). Useful to check which trials already run in Bern.

name: Swissmedic, medical devices
description: Swiss agency for therapeutic products. Regulatory information for medical devices: market access, clinical investigations with medical devices, vigilance and the Swiss medical device regulation (MedDO). Regulatory approval and certification questions for medtech companies.

name: Innosuisse innovation projects (national funding)
description: Innosuisse, the Swiss Innovation Agency, funds innovation projects carried out by Swiss companies together with a research partner such as the University of Bern or BFH, or on their own. The main public funding route for a company and a Bern research group to develop a product together.

name: Innosuisse support for start-ups
description: Innosuisse start-up offers: training, coaching, the Swiss Accelerator funding, international trade fairs and market tests. For start-ups being created, growing in Switzerland or expanding abroad.

name: Innosuisse project set-up assistance and networking
description: Innosuisse innovation mentors and networking offers that help a company set up an innovation project, find a research partner in Switzerland or abroad and build collaborations.

name: BRIDGE (SNSF and Innosuisse)
description: Funding programme run jointly by the SNSF and Innosuisse at the boundary between research and innovation: Proof of Concept for young researchers turning results into an application, and Discovery for research teams with high innovation potential.

name: Euresearch
description: Swiss information network on European research and innovation funding such as Horizon Europe and Eurostars. Advice for companies and research groups on EU calls and consortia. Head office in Bern.

name: Venture Kick
description: Philanthropic three-stage funding for Swiss start-ups, up to CHF 150,000 of early funding, with further equity from Kickfund. Relevant for spin-offs and young medtech and life science start-ups.

name: be-advanced
description: Innovation coaching for start-ups and SMEs in the Canton of Bern: founding a company, start-up coaching and SME development, supported by the canton.

name: sitem-insel
description: Swiss Institute for Translational and Entrepreneurial Medicine on the Inselspital campus in Bern. Translational medicine centre with lab and office space for start-ups and companies next to the university hospital, and support for moving medtech and life science ideas towards clinical use.

name: Switzerland Innovation Park Biel/Bienne
description: Innovation park in Biel/Bienne where applied research meets industry: research and technology services, space for companies and start-ups, meeting rooms and an academy. Part of the Switzerland Innovation network.

name: Swiss HealthTech Center (SIPBB)
description: Health technology centre at Switzerland Innovation Park Biel/Bienne. Works with start-ups, industry, academic institutions and healthcare professionals on medical technology, with support for innovation projects and industrial projects.

name: Switzerland Innovation (innovation parks network)
description: National network of Switzerland Innovation Parks, including Biel/Bienne, for R&D sites and collaboration between academia and industry.

name: Bern University of Applied Sciences (BFH)
description: Applied sciences university of the Canton of Bern, with 32 Bachelor's and 27 Master's programmes including engineering, health and life sciences, and continuing education. A source of graduates and applied research partners; talent and recruiting for engineering and medtech roles.

name: EURAXESS Switzerland
description: Information and support services for researchers moving to Switzerland: jobs, funding and mobility. Useful for talent and recruiting of international researchers.

name: Swiss Medtech
description: Association of the Swiss medical technology industry, about 700 members. Industry network and a voice on regulation and market access for medtech companies.

name: Swiss Biotech Association
description: Association of the Swiss biotech industry with news, events and a company directory. Industry network for life science and biotech companies.

name: Bern Economic Development Agency
description: One-stop shop of the Canton of Bern for companies that want to locate in the canton and grow: contacts and partners, finding premises and space, advice on permits, work permits and investment matters.
